technique_name: Describe the differences between an ARM and a RISC processor.
description: An ARM processor is an advanced Reduced Instruction Set Computer (RISC) technology that is used in mobile phones, tablets, and other portable electronic devices. It is a type of processor architecture that provides high-performance computing capabilities with relatively low power consumption. RISC processors, on the other hand, are simpler than ARM processors, but generally offer greater computing power and energy efficiency.
